content: The fundus of the stomach is the upper left portion of the stomach's body. It is anatomically separated from the rest of the stomach by an imaginary horizontal plane that passes through the cardiac orifice. As the rounded upper part of the stomach, the fundus serves as a site for the accumulation of gases that are produced during the process of chemical digestion. Additionally, it functions as a temporary storage area for undigested food, holding it for a duration of up to one hour.
